applicability: Declared conditionally independent hypothetical or supplied-unverified observations; explicit product and test-system mechanisms, local-safe R0/R1 experimental suggestions
numerical_path: Log-space posterior and 60-digit Decimal conditional entropy for gain and gain/cost
normalization_policy: After accepting at most 1e-12 outcome-total representation error, normalize each hypothesis outcome distribution to exactly one for inference and information calculations. Preserve raw table hashes and observation provenance; normalization is not calibration.
comparison_policy: 12 decimal posterior/margin/score representation; positive gain at 12 decimals required for selection; tied posterior ranks and experiment scores choose lexicographic ID. Tied hypotheses never satisfy separation. Not uncertainty or confidence.
provenance: Observation IDs and likelihoods are supplied model statements, not measured Evidence. Challenge origin receipt must separately bind sealed first execution to exactly one appended selected outcome.
